geometry.note: Marks a single named entrance to the Kamioka mine complex; OSM does not distinguish which of the mine's two named entrances (Atotsu, Mozumi) this node represents, and no source fetched this session resolves that.

method: OpenStreetMap node 759469233 (natural=cave_entrance, name 'Kamioka Mine, ICRR, Kamiokande, CLIO'), extracted via the maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror after overpass-api.de, lz4.overpass-api.de and the kumi mirror all refused connections this session. This node sits 1.87 km (bearing ~5.6 deg, i.e. almost due north) from Super-Kamiokande's own surveyed underground position — broadly consistent with the ~1.7-1.8 km horizontal Atotsu access tunnel described in secondary sources, though no primary source fetched this session states that tunnel length as a directly quotable figure, so this is reported as an informational corroboration in the worklog rather than a formal `checks[]` row.
